title: Credential ownership and ~/.ticfacrc: definition and migration path
description: SPEC §3.3, §4.3 / §12 Phase 0 step 5. Define which credentials belong to ticfac (model access, gateway, subscription brokers, GitHub App/install tokens, run tokens) versus ticks (none beyond git), the ~/.ticfacrc file schema, and how today's Factory credentials in ticks migrate. Include the stop-as-durable-refusal-to-issue rule and the flat-rate-seat (no cost budget) case. Document only, plus a schema fixture in the bundle.
notes: 2026-09-02 13:29 - Builds on a4n Phase 3 (9hu, credential file split, closed except docs tick c2b). Start from the decision recorded there; do not re-decide ownership of the thirty KeyFactory* keys.
acceptance_criteria: A doc section or file defines ownership per credential type and the ~/.ticfacrc schema; the schema is a bundle fixture with a validating example; the migration steps from current tk factory credentials are listed; the security posture (never print tokens, read-only grades) is preserved.
